description:
This package integrates Open Design Alliance ("ODA") CAD SDK v27.9 native binaries for Linux together with a ThinkGeo-authored managed wrapper assembly. Add it next to ThinkGeo.Cad to read CAD drawings on Linux; it is not intended to be used on its own.

Includes:
- The ThinkGeo wrapper assembly for Linux x64 under lib/linux-x64/net8.0/
- Open Design Alliance SDK v27.9 native binaries for Linux x64 (GCC 8.3 build) under nativedlls/

Supported Platforms: Linux x64 with .NET 8 or later. Minimum host OS: glibc 2.17 and libstdc++ from GCC 6 (GLIBCXX_3.4.22), so any distribution .NET 8 supports. glibc, libstdc++ and libgcc come from the host and are not bundled. Text in drawings is drawn with the host's fonts: install the fonts the drawings use, or metric-compatible ones such as fonts-liberation for Arial. For Windows, use ThinkGeo.Cad.Dependency.Windows.

Note: The ODA SDK binaries are proprietary and are redistributed under ODA's Publishing License and Copyright terms (https://docs.opendesign.com/tp/publish_license_copyright.html). They may only be redistributed as part of a finished application. See LICENSE.txt and README.md inside the package for details.
title: ThinkGeo Cad Dependency for Linux
